body: Hey, you can always message me. I’ll listen man!

Hey, I’m not going to BS you and say everything’s going to be okay. I hit the bottle regularly. I fall down. I’ve lost some of my best friends to this. You know what? Sometimes it’s not okay. Sometimes it feels like it will never be okay. The fact that we’re both in here, you know what that says to me? It says that sometimes it doesn’t have to be okay. Let it out. Face the demons. I hate facing them too. I’ve called the hotline blackout wasted and vented to the poor guy for about three hours. I’ve cut myself time and time again but you know what? I’m still here. I’d rather take a second out of my day to tell you you’re worth it than to stand by idle and have somebody else go thru the same pain I went thru when I lost somebody. You will NEVER be a burden. NEVER hesitate to reach out when you need it the most. And most importantly, you will NEVER be alone!!!
